Test coolant temperature sensor output
Check EVAP purge valve operation

codes.name: Transmission Fluid Level Sensor Circuit Low
codes.description: Transmission Fluid Level Sensor Circuit Low
causes: Short to ground on signal wire
Failed sensor outputting low or no voltage
Poor sensor ground or reference voltage
repairTips: Verify 5V reference supply at sensor connector
Check signal wire for short to ground
Inspect sensor connector for moisture or corrosion
Replace sensor if signal remains low after wiring check

codes.name: Transmission Fluid Level Sensor Circuit High
codes.description: Transmission Fluid Level Sensor Circuit High
symptoms: Sensor reading out of expected range
causes: Short to voltage in sensor signal wire
Open ground circuit causing floating high signal
repairTips: Check sensor reference voltage (typically 5V)
Inspect wiring for short to power
Verify sensor ground path
Replace sensor if voltage remains high after wiring check

codes.name: SCP (J1850) Invalid Or Missing Data For Primary Id
codes.description: SCP (J1850) Invalid or Missing Data for Primary Id
symptoms: Diagnostic trouble codes in multiple modules
causes: Short or open in network wiring
repairTips: Check CAN bus voltage levels (typically 2.5V ± 1V)
Inspect bus wiring for damage near connectors and harness bends
Disconnect modules one at a time to identify bus disruption source
Measure termination resistance across bus (should be ~60Ω)
Replace faulty module after thorough diagnosis

symptoms: Diagnostic trouble codes in multiple modules
causes: Short or open in network wiring
repairTips: Check CAN bus voltage levels (typically 2.5V ± 1V)
Inspect bus wiring for damage near connectors and harness bends
Disconnect modules one at a time to identify bus disruption source
Measure termination resistance across bus (should be ~60Ω)
Replace faulty module after thorough diagnosis

symptoms: Diagnostic trouble codes in multiple modules
causes: Short or open in network wiring
repairTips: Check CAN bus voltage levels (typically 2.5V ± 1V)
Inspect bus wiring for damage near connectors and harness bends
Disconnect modules one at a time to identify bus disruption source
Measure termination resistance across bus (should be ~60Ω)
Replace faulty module after thorough diagnosis
